name: Abyssal Warhound Pack Leader OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest

offensiveAbilities.name: Caustic Drool
offensiveAbilities.description:
Caustic saliva drips from the warhound's mouth. Until the end of its turn, the abyssal warhound's jaws Strike deals an additional 2 points of acid damage on a successful attack, or 4 points on a critical success.

Effect: Caustic Drool

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunting Call
offensiveAbilities.description: The pack leader throws its head back and lets out a bone-chilling howl. All abyssal warhounds and pack leaders with 30 feet that hear the call immediately activate their Caustic Drool ability as a free action. A creature that benefits from this effect becomes immune to this creature's call for one minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shake
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The abyssal warhound's Caustic Drool ability is active

Effect The warhound shakes its head, splattering nearby creatures with caustic saliva. All creatures within 10 feet of the warhound take 3d4 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw). Abyssal warhounds are immune to this damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Warning Growl
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature targets the warhound with a melee Strike

Effect The warhound Demoralizes the triggering creature and does not take a penalty for not speaking a language. The results of this check occur before resolving the triggering Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
